description: This PHP class 'TreeRule' defines a recursive rule evaluation structure used in AWS SDK's endpoint resolution logic, allowing nested rule evaluation.

classes.name: TreeRule
classes.description: A class representing a hierarchical rule structure that evaluates conditions and recursively processes subordinate rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TreeRule with a definitions array, creating subordinate rules.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the list of subordinate rules.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the rule against input parameters, recurses through subordinate rules upon success.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates a list of rule objects from an array of rule definitions using RuleCreator.
